alignment.understanding: AI Cleanup classifies whitespace-only source gaps between returned blocks as restored_whitespace_ranges and persists them as decision items with kind 'whitespace', but both re-render paths (_render_document and _render_validated_window) emit an empty string for that kind, so the gap text is deleted.
